scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w mint-server" "npm run dev -w mint-client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w mint-server && npm run build -w mint-client
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build -w mint-server && npm run electron:rebuild && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w mint-client" "sleep 3 && cd electron && npx electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:server: npm run build -w mint-server && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w mint-server" "npm run dev -w mint-client" "sleep 3 && cd electron && npx electron ."
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build -w mint-server && ELECTRON=true npm run build -w mint-client && cd electron && npm run build:mac
